#Corrrelation Plot
library(corrplot)
## corrplot 0.92 loaded
x <- cor(deertb,method="spearman")
corrplot(x, type="upper", order="hclust",)

#Correlation table
mcor<-round(cor(deertb,method="spearman"),2)
mcor

#prop of boar and deer pos in each farm.. in bar plot
df <- data.frame(rbind(deertb$ï..Farm,deertb$BoarPropPos,deertb$DeerPropPos))
colnames(df) = df[1,]
df = df[-1,]
rownames(df) = c('BoarPropPos','DeerPropPos')

barplot(as.matrix(df),col=c("orange1","skyblue"),border="black",
density=30, xlab="Farm ID", ylab="Proportion of TB pos Boar vs red deer", main="Proportion of TB positive Boar vs deer  in each farm ")
legend('topleft',legend=c("BoarPropPos","DeerPropPos"),col=c("orange1","skyblue"),lty=1)

# Number of TB positive boar from sampled in each farm
df1 = data.frame(rbind(deertb$ï..Farm,deertb$BoarSampledTB,deertb$BoarPosTB)
                )
colnames(df1) = df1[1,]
df1 = df1[-1,]
rownames(df1) = c('BoarSampledTB','BoarPosTB')

barplot(as.matrix(df1),col=c("blue","red"),border="black",
density=30, xlab="Farm ID", ylab="Number of Boar sampled vs positive", main="Number of TB positive boar from sampled in each farm ")
legend('topleft',legend=c("BoarSampledTB","BoarPosTB"),col=c("blue","red"),
lty=1)

# Number of TB positive deer from sampled in each farm
df2 = data.frame(rbind(deertb$ï..Farm,deertb$DeerSampledTB,deertb$DeerPosTB)
                )
colnames(df2) = df2[1,]
df2 = df2[-1,]
rownames(df2) = c('DeerSampledTB','DeerPosTB')

barplot(as.matrix(df2),col=c("blue","red"),border="black",
density=30, xlab="Farm ID", ylab="Number of deer sampled vs positive", main="Number of TB positive deer from sampled in each farm ")
legend('topleft',legend=c("DeerSampledTB","DeerPosTB"),col=c("blue","red"),
lty=1)
